title: Attention-sensitive calibration of shared Mirror KV cache translators

prior_art.fact: CacheBridge uses causal-attention-weighted calibration for cross-model KV transfer; Fisher-geometric objectives weight errors by functional sensitivity.
prior_art.mirror_question: For a shared low-description KV translation basis with task-specific Mirror coordinates, does attention-sensitive calibration preserve attention distributions and outputs better than raw cache MSE at the same actual bytes?

scope: Synthetic two-model causal-attention KV translation mechanism screen; not a language model or CacheBridge reproduction.

task.source_cache: Independent Gaussian source K and V vectors per context/token.
task.aligned_teacher: For each of four contexts, target K and V maps are output-Givens rotations of one shared seeded 4x4 map, with context-specific angles.
task.independent_teacher: Four unrelated full 4x4 target K and V maps.
task.attention: Causal softmax(Q K^T / sqrt(4)); train/query Q values are independently sampled Gaussian. Compare target attention probabilities, outputs and argmax-key NLL.
task.data: Separate calibration, dev and audit sequences generated from world seeds. All four context IDs appear in calibration.

methods.independent_raw: Four independent full K/V linear mappers, trained by raw cache MSE.
methods.independent_attention: Four independent full K/V mappers trained by attention output MSE plus target-to-predicted attention KL; strong upper reference.
methods.mirror_raw: One shared K/V mapping basis plus two per-context Givens angles, trained by raw cache MSE.
methods.mirror_attention: Same shared bases and code count as mirror_raw, trained by attention output MSE plus attention KL.
methods.basis2_attention: Two unrestricted shared K/V mapping bases with per-context coefficients, trained by attention loss.
methods.shared_attention: One shared K/V mapper without context code, trained by attention loss.

training.selection: Per-method update count minimizing average dev attention-output MSE pooled over aligned and independent worlds; evaluate every 25 updates.
training.audit: Freeze model/update selection before generating audit query sequences.

metrics.storage: Pack all deployed K/V mapping tensors and task codes to Safetensors; schema/layout metadata included in actual file bytes.

success_gate: On aligned teachers, mirror_attention has lower mean held-out attention-output MSE than mirror_raw in at least 2/3 audit worlds without increasing actual payload bytes; attention KL and target NLL must not regress by more than 5% relative to independent_attention. Report off-orbit failures.
failure_gate: FAIL if attention calibration does not improve Mirror attention metrics over raw cache-MSE Mirror in at least 2/3 aligned worlds, or if quality/storage gates fail. Off-orbit independent matrices are boundary evidence.
boundaries: No autoregressive token generation, target-model likelihood or natural cache-transfer result.
Causal masks are mandatory in every attention calculation.
Aligned target maps are deliberately Mirror-compatible; no generic cross-model claim.
All calibration and query compute is CPU synthetic and excludes a pretrained backbone.
